snippet.description:
Learn how to find the Radius of Curvature (Vakrata Trijya) for Cartesian curves using Newton's Method. This B.Sc. The Maths tutorial in Hindi covers Maclaurin's series, the proof of Newton's formula, and solved examples.

📲 Connect with Fractal Frontier:
📱 Telegram: https://t.me/fractalfrontiermaths
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mathsworld007
🌐 Website: https://drpraveendra.org
📝 Lecture Notes and Previous Year Question Papers: https://drpraveendra.org/resources

Dosto, aaj ke is video mein hum Calculus ka ek bahut hi important topic "Radius of Curvature" (Vakrata Trijya) continue karenge. Is lecture mein humne advanced level problems solve kiye hain aur seekha hai ki Newton's Method ka use karke origin par curvature kaise nikaalte hain.

Is video mein cover kiya gaya hai:
✅ Newton's Method for Radius of Curvature at origin.
✅ Maclaurin's Series expansion ka use karke curvature nikalna.
✅ Important exam questions ka solution.

⏱️ TIMESTAMPS:
00:00 – Introduction to Radius of Curvature
00:56 – Proof: $1/\rho = d/dx(dy/ds)$ for Cartesian Curves
06:12 – Example: Finding Radius of Curvature for $s^2 = 8ay$
13:13 – Concept of Tangents at Origin for Algebraic Curves
14:20 – Newton’s Method for Radius of Curvature (Theory & Statement)
15:59 – Proof of Newton’s Method using Maclaurin’s Expansion
23:04 – Example 1: Radius of Curvature for Folium of Descartes $x^3 + y^3 = 3axy$ at Origin
32:43 – Example 2: Finding Radius of Curvature for $ay^2 - x^2 = x^3$ at Origin
41:50 – Example 3: Curvature of $y^2 = x^2(a+x)/(a-x)$ using Expansion Method
50:38 – Summary & Introduction to Parametric Forms (Next Lecture)

Agar aap B.Sc. 1st year ya competitive exams ki taiyari kar rahe hain, toh ye lecture aapki kaafi help karega. Video ko end tak dekhein aur koi doubt ho toh comment karein!

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

🔗 Previous Lecture:
Radius of Curvature Cartesian Formula & Examples
→ https://youtu.be/vEYGqJQsYJo

📺 Complete Playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ2PtdP6tVW8

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd
